Genuinely a hang, not a slow test: this mutant replaces the component's whole body with {} (an
implicit `return undefined`). @testing-library/react-native's `render()` - awaited by every test
here - never settles when the root component itself renders nothing, confirmed by hand: raising
Stryker's own timeoutMS to 30000 (6x the default) made no difference, so jest's own per-test timeout
never gets a chance to fire either - this blocks synchronously, it doesn't just run long. The
component's real behavior (rendering its children inside the shared wrapper) is fully covered by
this same file's tests; only the mutated, empty-body version hangs.
